node.statement: Once nodes 1.2.1 and 1.2.2 are validated, every corner element has both uniformly accurate compressed representatives and the two middle target projections satisfy ||p_kp_l||=O(e) for k!=l. The compatible case is the compressed-product estimate in def-compressed-corner; the incompatible case is obtained by the three associator moves displayed in node 1.2.3. Thus its universal c_prod,c_cross estimates follow and discharge node 1.2.
